name: Power Finance Corporation Ltd.
business_summary: Government-controlled (55.99%) Maharatna NBFC, India's largest power-sector lender (generation, transmission, distribution, increasingly renewables); consolidated with ~52.6% owned REC Ltd (model knowledge), combined loan book ~Rs11 lakh cr. Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs7,682cr (-2% y/y), H1 Rs16,679cr; FY26 PAT Rs33,625cr. Trades at 0.73x book, 4.1x earnings, 5.6% dividend yield, -21% in 3 months on bank competition, loan-growth downgrades (REC guidance cut to 10-11%) and a Morgan Stanley downgrade. RBI cleared the PFC-REC merger (NOC 2026-10-16); swap ratio reported at 88:100, pending shareholder/creditor/other approvals.

revenue_mix.segment: interest on loans to state utilities/discoms/gencos
loans to central/private generation, transmission, renewables

exposures.mechanism: Funding is ~Rs9.8 lakh cr (Q2 consolidated interest Rs18,058cr x4 / ~7.4%), mostly AAA bonds priced off G-secs; 10y +25bp raises fresh/refinance cost (~Rs1.5 lakh cr/yr to roll) by ~Rs375cr in yr1 = ~1% of PBT (TTM financing profit Rs42,511cr), partly passed to resetting loans; plus a +25bp rise in cost of equity on a 4x-P/E, 5.6%-yield bond-proxy stock (-1.5%). Net ~-2.5; pack shows US 10y elasticity -1.18 (t=-1.6), consistent in sign.

evidence.note: 10y G-sec closed 7.19% on 2026-11-04 after 7.48% on 2026-10-23 (Moneycontrol 2026-11-04; BusinessLine 2026-10-23)
PFC Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs7,682cr (-2% y/y), H1 Rs16,679cr, 2nd interim dividend declared (NDTV Profit/Zee 2026-11-04)

exposures.mechanism: SSU: +1 = banks take ~5pp of power/infra lending share or compress spreads ~25bp. 25bp on Rs11 lakh cr = Rs2,750cr = 6.5% of PBT; offset by volume 30%, persistence 0.75 => ~-3.5 plus growth-downgrade effect (REC cut FY27 loan growth to 10-11%; Bernstein cut targets) => -6. Already partly priced after -21% in 3m.
